title: Global E Invoicing & Tax Reporting in 2026 and Beyond: Adoption, Mandates, and What Comes Next
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
E‑invoicing and digital tax reporting have moved from periodic compliance to continuous, real‑time transaction controls. As mandates expand across Europe, Latin America, and beyond, enterprises face increasing risk from fragmented requirements, invoice rejection, and operational disruption.


In this co‑hosted webinar, **Vertex and Deloitte** will explore how global adoption of e‑invoicing and tax reporting is evolving, and what enterprises should expect next. Our experts will draw on insights aligned with the 2026 Billentis report covering adoption trends, mandate trajectories, and market forecasts through 2030.


## What You’ll Learn


- **Where** global e-invoicing and tax reporting mandates are live, and where they’re accelerating
- **How** invoice volumes and electronic invoice penetration are expected to evolve heading into 2026
- **What** forecasts for 2026–2030 mean for enterprise compliance, cash flow, and IT scalability
- **Why** enterprises must treat e invoicing as a continuous business risk, not a one time project
